description: Render markdown content with progressive enhancement. Supports external files, inline content, pluggable parsers, and VB theme integration.

attributes.name: allow-cross-origin
attributes.description: Permit a src on another origin (CORS still applies; content is still sanitized unless sanitize="off"). Without it src must be same-origin http(s); redirects are re-checked

attributes.name: sanitize
attributes.description: Sanitizing is on unless this is "off" or "false" (any other value, or no attribute, keeps it on). Off writes parser output raw with innerHTML: trusted first-party markdown only, never with a cross-origin or user-influenced src

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Fire per-block markdown-viewer:highlight events after render

attributes.name: ping
attributes.description: URL to ping with render metadata via sendBeacon

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Text of the role="alert" message shown when src fails to load or parse and no <pre> fallback is visible

attributes.name: data-auto-mermaid
attributes.description: Upgrade ```mermaid fences in the rendered output to <diagram-wc> (main.js loads the markdown-mermaid bridge when present)

attributes.name: data-error
attributes.description: Present if fetch or parse fails

events.name: markdown-viewer:rendered
events.description: Fired after parse and render complete

events.name: markdown-viewer:highlight
events.description: Fired per code block when highlight attribute is set

events.name: markdown-viewer:error
events.description: Fired on fetch or parse failure

properties.name: parser
properties.description: Custom parser function (markdown string → HTML string). Overrides the default marked parser. Its output is still sanitized unless sanitize="off"

properties.name: markdown
properties.description: Get the current markdown source, or set a string to render it instead of the slots/src (null or '' falls back to them)

methods.name: render()
methods.description: Force a re-render from the current content source

methods.name: reload()
methods.description: Re-fetch the src URL and re-render
